description: Move one of the signed-in person's own upcoming bookings (the free intro call or an hour with Ben, by its id from my_bookings, where canMove is true) to another open time of the same kind: for an hour with Ben a start from openHours, for the free intro call a start from introCall.moveTimes. Pass the start exactly as listed, and name the new time by its label, never by a weekday you work out. Nothing is charged: an hour keeps its diamond, the call stays free, and the calendar sends the updated invite. The answer's booking has the new label. Refused, with a reason, for a booking that is not theirs, already cancelled, begun, still waiting for the calendar, or a time that is not open.

bookingId.description: The id of one of the person's own upcoming bookings, exactly as my_bookings lists it.

start.description: The new start, exactly as my_bookings lists it for that kind of booking: openHours for an hour with Ben, introCall.moveTimes for the free intro call, e.g. "2026-09-18T11:30:00.000+02:00".

timeZone.description: The person's time zone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin". Defaults to the booking's own.

name: move_booking
